campaign_scope: Only the three order-17 side classes with exact small counts are submitted. No large-class generation or classification has been submitted.
resource_policy: Every job uses partition=research_cpu, qos=researcher, and matching gres=cpuonly:N and cpus-per-task=N.
audit_gate: Each next class is released only after the preceding audit exits successfully. Audits require exact index coverage, no malformed rows, no duplicate index/hash rows, no timeouts, and fixed-span confirmation for every primary negative.
